description:
Problem.
(a) start_batch in scripts/batch_integration.py accepts a single member; #4015 ran with one, which is serial work with batch overhead.
(b) Frozen scopes omit files every change may be obliged to touch (its changelog.d fragment, docs/internal/dev-loop-property-ledger.md). A leader fix cannot widen scope, so batch hold-label-and-batch-e2e had to be aborted to add a ledger row.
(c) Scope is checked only at landing, after review cost is paid.
(d) batch-member-check runs a local review whose result is never trusted, then the leader reviews the same patch at landing. A 2-member batch costs 5 local reviews against 2 for serial PRs, and each review depends on the review gateway. The owner decided on 2026-11-07 to drop the member-check review.

Change.
(1) batch-start refuses fewer than two members, with a message pointing to serial mode.
(2) batch-start appends changelog.d/* and docs/internal/dev-loop-property-ledger.md to every member's scope before computing scope_hash.
(3) batch-member-check refuses a changed path outside the member's frozen scope, with the same message batch-land uses.
(4) batch-member-check no longer runs _review_member_patch. It runs the preflight, the changelog check and the mapped/named tests only, and records no member review. batch-land's trusted review is unchanged.
(5) Update the batch-feature-delivery.md command-table rows for batch-start and batch-member-check, and the section 2 member bullet about the member review.
(6) Update the unit tests (tests/unit/scripts/test_batch_integration.py, batch_loop_world.py) and the e2e world (tests/integration/worktree/) for the new behaviour.
(7) One changelog.d fragment (internal).

Delivery: serial, not in a batch. This changes the batch loop itself, and batch-feature-delivery.md forbids a batch certifying the loop. It runs in parallel with batch batch-optin-remediation-20261107; its files are disjoint from that batch's members, apart from different hunks of batch-feature-delivery.md.

Guardrails: work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, or the batch targets for members); never edit the primary clone; stage paths explicitly; no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check); heavy work only via make heavy-run, never forcing admission; never bypass a required check, ruleset, hold label or oracle gate; re-read each cited file on current origin/develop before editing, because line numbers drift.
